scope: One training seed; the same 24 validation scenes are repeatedly evaluated. Scene-paired bootstrap intervals are exploratory, conditional on this seed and validation distribution; not independent confirmation or across-seed uncertainty.
final_model_rule: PPO32768 and continued BC2048 are predeclared endpoints; no validation winner selection.

comparison_boundaries.fixed_work: H16; 2,000,000 shared soft work; frozen originals have no comparable work/reward.
comparison_boundaries.full_time: Complete scene-to-plan 0.4 s soft deadline, including preprocessing and final verification; overruns retained.
comparison_boundaries.timing: Scene generation, disk model loading, JSON serialization outside complete_s; model loading reported separately.
comparison_boundaries.intervals: Paired scene percentile bootstrap, 10000 replicates; pooled estimates are unstratified; no multiple-comparison adjustment.
comparison_boundaries.p95: Empirical linear-interpolation 95th percentile across scene rows.
